# S-014 -- Home: Your Stats and Your Walls carousel

Home is where the user lands after sharing a response. It shows a Your Stats
panel and a Your Walls carousel of wall cards, and it is the hub for moving into
individual walls. This screen supersedes and upgrades the basic `app/wall.tsx`.

## AC

- [ ] The screen shows a Your Stats panel with a chart placeholder.
- [ ] The screen shows a Your Walls carousel with wall cards (Personal, Family)
  and an add-wall (+) affordance.
- [ ] Tapping a wall card navigates into that wall (the Family grid, S-016).
- [ ] This screen supersedes/upgrades the basic `app/wall.tsx`.
- [ ] The screen ships first as a skeleton with working navigation, then design
  fidelity follows in a later pass.
- [ ] The screen renders and behaves identically on the web export and on an
  iOS/Android device or simulator from the single Expo/React Native codebase.
